newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH CBANK APPROVES BLG INTERBANKA STAKE PURCHASE.
newsitem.headline: CZECH CBANK APPROVES BLG INTERBANKA STAKE PURCHASE.

text.p: The Czech National Bank (CNB) on Monday said it had given its approval to the purchase of a 55 percent stake in Interbanka a.s. by German Bayerische Landesbank Girozentrale (BLG).
CNB spokesman Pavel Palivec added that the central bank had also approved the purchase of a 45 percent stake in Interbanka to Kulkereskedelmi, a Hungarian foreign trade bank.
"The central bank has given its approval of the purchase of Interbanka shares," Palivec told Reuters.
BLG already holds a 50 percent stake in the Hungarian bank.
No details of the purchase were immediately available.
Interbanka, established in 1994, holds a universal Czech banking licence. It currently has basic capital of 500 million crowns, and a balance sheet of some three billion crowns.
